case.summary: Transaction 3538486 on card C06532-K2 for $149.92 was flagged by the second-generation model with an exceptionally high score of 0.998. Knowledge graph analysis revealed that device D008998 was utilized three minutes earlier on an unrelated card, C05116-K1, for a near-identical online purchase of $150.05. This late-night online transaction for product H directly deviates from card C06532-K2's baseline pattern of in-person retail spending on product W. The rapid cross-card reuse of the device across multiple accounts confirms card-not-present fraud. Consequently, the transaction is confirmed as fraudulent, card C06532-K2 is blocked, and connected card C05116-K1 is placed on monitoring.

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details card-not-present fraud identified across customer accounts C06532 (card C06532-K2) and C05116 (card C05116-K1). On December 13, 2016, at 03:56:20 UTC, an unauthorized online transaction (ID 3538486) was conducted on card C06532-K2 in the amount of $149.92 for product H in billing region 315. The transaction was conducted using device D008998, which exhibited a profile of Windows 7 running Chrome 60.0. Approximately three minutes earlier, at 03:53:00 UTC, the same device D008998 was used to conduct transaction 3538480 for $150.05 on unrelated card C05116-K1 for the same product category H. Card C06532-K2's established account history consists predominantly of in-person retail purchases for product W, accounting for 258 of 281 prior transactions. The rapid sequential execution of near-identical late-night online purchases across different cardholders indicates coordinated card-not-present fraud utilizing stolen card data. The bank's secondary fraud detection model scored transaction 3538486 at 0.998, which corresponds to a 92.1% historical fraud rate. Total identified fraudulent exposure for card C06532-K2 is $149.92. Card C06532-K2 has been blocked from further authorization attempts, and connected card C05116-K1 has been placed under heightened monitoring.
